import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Extract each nonzero connected component and concatenate its bounding box left-to-right by color.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==color:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells); c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            shape=[[grid[y][x] for x in range(c0,c1+1)] for y in range(r0,r1+1)]
            objs.append((color,shape))
    objs.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
    out=[[] for _ in range(max(len(s) for _,s in objs))]
    for _,s in objs:
        for i,row in enumerate(s): out[i].extend(row)
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
